title: KPDCL Announces Scheduled Power Shutdowns Across Srinagar, South Kashmir - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: The Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has announced a series of scheduled power shutdowns across Srinagar and several areas of South Kashmir during November 2026 to facilitate maintenance works on transmission lines and grid infrastructure.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdown of the 132/33 kV, 100 MVA Grid Station Khunmoh will affect Wuyen, Balhama, Munpora, Befina, Zafran Colony, Khonmoh Checksangri, JKAP, TCI Old Cement Plant, Industrial Area Khonmoh, SAIFCO Cement Plant, KHYBER Cement Plant, TCI MAX Cement Plant and adjoining areas from 9 am to 3 pm on November 15.
In another shutdown, power supply to Wanpora, Khanda, Sanzipora, Magraypora, Kuzwaira, Gowharpora, Kultreh, Barigound, Bharampora and Wadipora will remain affected from 10 am to noon on November 7 due to maintenance work on the 33 kV Khanda Tapline.
The 33 kV Awantipora-Sangam (Sangam-1st) line will remain shut from 10 am to 3 pm on November 5, affecting Mehand, Khiram, Sirhama, Nowshera, Marhama, Sangam and Halmullag.
Meanwhile, shutdowns of the 33 kV Bemina-Fatehkadal and 33 kV Bemina-Barbarshah lines on November 5 and 11, from 9 am to 3 pm, will affect K.K Moulla, Nowpora, Bohrikadal, BB Shah, Babademb, Bishembarnagar, Gousia Hospital, Naisarak, Barbarshah, Exchange, Basant Bagh, Car Parking and Maisuma Bazar.
Power supply to Zadibal, Mughal Masjid, Kawdara, Rajouri Kadal, Jamia Masjid, Firdous Colony and Bacchi Darwaza will be affected from 9 am to 3 pm on November 5 and 9 due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Wanganpora-Kawdara Mughal Masjid line.
In South Kashmir, the 33 kV Kulgam-DH Pora line will remain shut from 10 am to 3 pm on November 11 and 16, affecting DH Pora, KB Pora, Nillow, Arreh, Begam and adjoining areas.
Similarly, the shutdown of the 33 kV Kulgam-Yaripora line on November 10 and 14, from 10 am to 3 pm, will affect Yaripora, Behibagh, Tarigam and Sampora.
The 33 kV Kulgam-Devsar line will remain shut from 10 am to 3 pm on November 16 and 18, affecting Devsar, Sopat, Akhal and Hablish.
Power supply to Qaimoh, Khudwani and Redwani will be affected from 10 am to 3 pm on November 5 and 7 due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Wanpoh-Qaimoh line.
Similarly, the 33 kV Wanpoh-Qazigund line will remain shut from 10 am to 3 pm on November 9 and 11, affecting Mirbazar, Vessu, Nipora, Qazigund town, Railway Station and adjoining areas.
